# GoGlobal

> GoGlobal is a global opportunities platform that helps students and early professionals discover opportunities from around the world.

## About GoGlobal

GoGlobal brings global opportunities together in one platform so students can discover programs without searching across multiple websites and communities.

The platform focuses on helping users discover opportunities based on their interests, goals, location and career aspirations.

## Global Opportunities

GoGlobal helps users discover:

- Internships
- Scholarships
- Fellowships
- Research programs
- Conferences
- Hackathons
- Competitions
- Leadership programs
- Mentorship programs
- Startup programs
- Exchange programs
- Networking events
- Volunteering opportunities
- Global career opportunities
- Remote opportunities

## Opportunity Discovery

Users can explore opportunities by category, location, work mode, funding, deadline and other relevant criteria.

GoGlobal aims to make global opportunities more accessible, discoverable and actionable for students.
